# Where to find and how to farm for Poison Resistance food buffs in Fallout 76

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Aug 30, 2023
- 3 min read

Updated: Oct 6, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_8b20ef41c02a4933958358226813cab7~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit: __SugarBombs.RADS__ on Twitter X. 

With special thanks to Cassi and Souls.

While there is a long list of creatures that use poison attacks, there are minimal options in relation to poison resistance.

Enemies and items that use Poison Attacks include:

- Floater Gnasher Poison
- Floater Gnasher Corrosive Poison
- Mirelurk Hunter Spit Attack
- Trog Acid Reflux
- Trog Vomit Hazard (seriously who is naming these attacks)
- Wendigo Colossus Poison Vomit
- Floater Gnasher Death Hazard
- Mirelurk Queen Spit Attack
- Toxic Blood Daily Ops mutation
- Danger Cloud Daily Ops mutation
- Dr Blackburn Tantrum Poison Hazard
- Sheepsquatch Poison attack
- Toxic Alien Death Hazard
- Stingwing Poison
- Mirelurk King Poison damage
- Glowing Angler Poison damage
- Bloodbug Poison damage
- Ultramite Mole Rats during the Seismic Activity event
- Toxic and Acidic Gulpers during the Moonshine Jamboree public event
- Thistle Poisonous Smoke
- Pitcher Plant Poisonous Smoke
- Sundew Grove Poisonous Smoke
- Heart of the Swamp Strangler Heart Poison Smoke
- Toxic Valley Poisonous Smoke
- Scorchbeast and Scorchbeast Queen crop dusting

__Tips and Tricks__

Poison Resistance food buffs will stack on top of each other. So consuming two Tato Soups will offer +75 poison resist for 30 minutes.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_bb71ce5863204602a6af543a01fe6378~mv2.png)

Server hop to change your Camp Ally's inventory. Avoid going back to the same server as their inventory spawn may be the same.

__Cave Fungus__ 

The recipe for Cave Fungus soup automatically unlocks when you pick up Cave Fungus for the first time.

| **Location** | **% Drop Chance** | 
| Communist "Proletariat" Collectron | 0.78% | 

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_1c796c346823430aa81c655ff27fc836~mv2.jpg)

__Cave Fungus Soup__

This can be crafted from Cave Fungus (equip Super Duper perk card to yield better results) and drops from the Communist Collectron.

| **Location** | **% Drop Chance** | 
| Communist "Proletariat" Collectron | 0.78% | 

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0193bbaed4c24307af406bba3d29fd5e~mv2.jpg)

The Communist Collectron can be purchased from the Atom Shop or by visiting Bethesda's __support page__ and requesting the item. 

If you wish to choose a different skinned collectron such as the raider or communist bot, simply use the terminal attached to the collectron base and select "Proletariat" for the Communist food loot pool.

Note: If you are using the FETCH skin collectron, his loot pool is diluted with his default settings so he will always have circuitry and whatever collectron function you choose.

__Steeped Black Boodleaf Tea__

| **Location** | **% Drop Chance** | 
| Yasmin Lite Camp Ally | 5.88% | 
| Grandma Junko Lite Campy Ally | 6.25% | 

#### __Yasmin__ is obtainable from

- Season 3 scoreboard - The Scribe of Avalon (free)
- Gold Bullion - Samuel at Foundation once you have reached Ally status with the Settlers (4000 Gold Bullion).

#### __Grandma Junko__ is obtainable from

- Season 14 scoreboard - Fight for Freedom
- Gold Bullion - Samuel at Foundation or Mortimer at Crater (TBC) once you have reached Ally status (4000 Gold Bullion).

__Black Bloodleaf__

| **Location** | **% Drop Chance** | 
| Budding Apothecary Collector | 5.56% | 

There is no recipe for Steeped Black Bloodleaf Tea in game currently so you can not do anything with this plant.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_820a1b82f08c4ae78bc2ddb5314c0d86~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e27966b3ca9f4cf38f35b78830ac676d~mv2.png)

The Budding Apothecary Collector can be purchased from the Atom Shop for 700 atoms or by visiting Bethesda's __support page__ and requesting the item. 

__Tato Soup__

| **Location** | **% Drop Chance** | 
| Whitesprings Restaurant | 29.39% | 
| Communist "Proletariat" Collectron | 0.78% | 

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_8e0d09010f42471783f83e424f44caf4~mv2.jpg)

How to find the Whitespring Resort Restaurant:

Fast Travel to The Whitesprings Resort and select " Whitespring Refuge".

Take the stairs on the left up to the main room.

Turn South and run forward, through the doorway.

Turn NE and run over to the couch against the far wall.

Turn SE and run forward, veering right to enter the gap between the Tato Venison Stew sign and the Butler Protectron.

Walk forward and sit down at any of the white square tables and one of the robots will come over and serve you.
